errors.quote: the time must fall below every constant multiple of $n\log n$ along some inputs.
errors.problem: The quantity in question is the worst-case time T_A(n) over all inputs of length n, so what must fall below c n lg n (for every c>0) is the worst-case time at arbitrarily large input lengths n, not the time on 'some inputs'. The paper states the negation as one machine with liminf_{n->infinity} T_A(n)/(n lg n) = 0 (lines 384-385). Read literally, 'along some inputs' would let a machine that is fast only on particular inputs count as a counterexample.
